Activision is a developer, publisher, and distributor of interactive entertainment and video games. The company is seeking students for 2027 software engineering internships involving backend engineering, DevOps, release engineering, and tools engineering to support game development workflows, infrastructure, automation, and releases.
Gaming
Media and Entertainment
Publishing
PC Games
Video Games
No H1B
Responsibilities
Build backend systems and tools that support data-driven optimization across game development workflows. Collaborate with engineers and content creators to analyze performance, streamline pipelines, and improve developer tools
Build and support custom tools that streamline game development workflows. Contribute to scripting, automation, and front-end interfaces for internal systems used by designers and engineers. Collaborate across teams to improve developer experience and infrastructure
Support the technology and processes that power game releases across Activision studios. Partner with engineers to improve build pipelines, automate workflows, and help teams deliver high-quality game updates and releases
Come work on interesting challenges that will improve the workflows of everyone working on Call of Duty. We work on developer tools, back-end hardware, cloud infrastructure, and more!

Required
Currently enrolled in an associate's, bachelor's, or master's degree program and graduating December 2027 – June 2028
Exhibits learning agility; has the ability to think differently, and/or grasp and apply new skills and concepts
Approaches problems in a clear, well-organized, and solutions-oriented manner
Works well with others and contributes to team tasks
Able to effectively communicate problems, solutions, needs, or priorities
Is engaged, seeks to learn, and is able to manage time effectively
A passion for significantly impacting game development
Experience with C++, Python, or C# in software development
Familiarity with SQL, Spark, or Presto for data analysis
Exposure to game engines (Unreal, Unity) and debugging tools
Interest in backend systems, build pipelines, and performance optimization
Skilled in Python, JavaScript, and Linux/Unix environments
Experience with GitHub, Perforce, and CI/CD pipelines
Familiar with front-end frameworks and web development
Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS or GCP
Passionate about game design, tooling, and developer productivity
Experience with Python, C#, or other scripting/programming languages
Familiarity with software development, build systems, or CI/CD pipelines
Interest in automation, DevOps, and release management
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Ability to collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams
Passion for gaming and technology
Exhibits learning agility and can quickly apply new skills and concepts
Proficient in at least one common language (C/C++, Go, Python, Rust) and familiarity with others
Understanding of source control
Familiarity with both IDE and CLI-based workflows
Knowledge of (or curious about!) any of the following: Windows and Linux internals, networking (and network security), container development, and data storage methods
Benefits
All interns will have the option to opt into relocation services (flights, trains, or car mileage reimbursement).
All interns will be provided with a living stipend to subsidize housing, utility, commuting, and miscellaneous costs.
Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance, subject to eligibility requirements.
401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching, subject to eligibility requirements.
Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave, subject to eligibility requirements.
Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others, subject to eligibility requirements.
If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.
